items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts USDA Foundation 'Cream, heavy' as a bounded nutrition reference for the target explicitly labeled dairy cream at 35% fat. The retained record is a non-cultured heavy cream rather than sour cream or cream cheese, but it does not certify an exact 35% fat formulation, brand, homogenization, stabilizers, whipping state, or regional labeling standard; confidence is therefore medium. Nutrition remains the USDA per-100-g reference with no serving, volume-to-mass, or fat-percentage adjustment. This decision is specific to the 35% target and does not authorize reuse for the unresolved 30%, 15%, double-cream, crème-fraîche, or plant-based cream identities.
